title: In This Town, Being Bored Is A Medical Emergency

publish.title: Being BORED Is A Medical Emergency In This Town #shorts
publish.description: In this town, saying "I'm bored" gets you rushed to the hospital, but the doctor finds out who is really sick. How many hours did you scroll today?
publish.caption: In this town, being bored is a medical emergency 🚑😴

scenes.line: In this town, being *bored* is a medical emergency.
scenes.title: IN THIS TOWN...

scenes.line: Say the words out loud, and an *ambulance* shows up.
Grandpa once yawned at a *wedding*. Two helicopters came.
So everyone here stays *busy*. Very, very busy.
My brother Max wanted to build a *fort* with me.
I said *later*. I was busy scrolling.
He asked again. And *again*. I said later every time.
Then Max sat down, sighed, and *said* it.
I'm... *bored*.
Sirens. Lights. Doctors *everywhere*.
They checked his fun levels. Dangerously *low*.
They rushed him to the Boredom *Unit*.
Mom cried. Grandpa cried. I just felt *weird*.
The doctor tried everything. First, a *cake*.
Max looked at it. *Nothing*.
Then a magic show. Then a dancing *doctor*.
His fun level dropped to *one* percent.
The doctor turned around and looked straight at *me*.
She asked when I last *played* with my brother.
I checked my phone. Nine hours of *scrolling*. Today.
She scanned me next. The machine started *screaming*.
Max wasn't the sick one. *I* was.
I had been bored for a *week* and never noticed.
The cure was not a pill. It was a *fort*.
So I dropped my phone in the hospital *bin*.
And we built the biggest fort this hospital ever *saw*.
Max's fun level went up. Fifty. Eighty. One *hundred*.
Mine too. The machine played a little *song*.
Even the doctor crawled *inside*. She said it was research.
Now we build one fort every single *day*.
My phone? It gets one hour. Then it goes to *sleep*.
And nobody in my house has said those two words *since*.
Well. Except Grandpa. But he just likes the *helicopters*.
